👋 Welcome to Climb Running Head Tower
❓ Do you have what it takes to reach the top… or will you get caught?

Join the group for free BAT! https://www.roblox.com/communities/768806511

🛠️ Next Update: ❓

💡 A creepy entity known as the Running Head hunts players inside a cursed tower, constantly chasing anyone who tries to climb. Your goal is simple—reach the top while avoiding it at all costs. Each stage becomes more intense, introducing faster heads, harder paths, and less time to react. Survive the chase and escape to win.

Tags: Running Head, Horror, Scary, Monster, Chase, Multiplayer, Jumpscare, Survival, Tower, Climb, Obby, Cursed
